exercises.question: Which sentence takes the indicative?
options: Estoy seguro de que tiene razón. [I am sure he/she is right.]
No estoy seguro de que tenga razón. [I am not sure he/she is right.]
Dudo que tenga razón. [I doubt he/she is right.]

exercises.english: I am sure he/she is right.
I am not sure he/she is right.

sentences: Primero, Marta presentó su idea. [First, Marta presented her idea.]
Después, Luis la escuchó con atención. [Then Luis listened to it carefully.]
Finalmente, Luis dijo: «Estoy seguro de que tiene razón». [Finally, Luis said: “I am sure she is right.”]

problema [problem]
diferencia [difference]
